title: AI是最大采样器：will.i.am不慌，人类造了它，谁该慌？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: AI is just like the world's biggest sampler. It's sampled everything.
segments.zh: AI就像世界上最大的采样器，它采样了一切。

segments.en: Whether it's books, language, the machine is freaking amazing.
segments.zh: 无论是书籍还是语言，机器都令人惊叹。

segments.en: But humans are even more amazing. We made the machine.
segments.zh: 但人类更了不起，因为我们创造了机器。

segments.en: Will I am musician and technologist? You don't ever worry about like the amount of material being scraped.
segments.zh: 作为音乐家和科技专家，你会担心自己的作品被大量抓取吗？

segments.en: They're being AI-generated versions of yours. You can accept that.
segments.zh: AI生成的版本可能会存在，你能接受吗？

segments.en: You're asking the wrong question. The question you should ask, are you worried that you don't own your voice?
segments.zh: 你问错了问题。你应该问的是，你担心自己不拥有自己的声音吗？

segments.en: Everybody. Not just musicians. Every single person needs to own their data, their essence, their likeness.
segments.zh: 每个人，不仅仅是音乐家，都需要拥有自己的数据、本质和形象。

segments.en: You got to use your imagination and push industries to protect people in this new realm that we're in.
segments.zh: 你必须发挥想象力，推动行业在这个新领域保护人们。

segments.en: From Bloomberg Weekend, this is the Michelle Hussein show.
segments.zh: 欢迎收听彭博周末节目，这里是米歇尔·侯赛因秀。

segments.en: It's now more than 30 years since a group came together in Los Angeles who went on to become known all over the world as the Black Eyed Peas.
segments.zh: 三十多年前，一群人在洛杉矶聚在一起，后来他们以“黑眼豆豆”闻名世界。

segments.en: For that entire time, they've had the same frontman, Will I Am, who was raised by a single mother.
segments.zh: 这段时间里，主唱一直是Will I Am，他由单亲妈妈抚养长大。

segments.en: And in fact, it is with her that his long and deep journey into music began.
segments.zh: 事实上，正是与母亲一起，他开始了漫长而深刻的音乐之旅。

segments.en: Because when he was 14, she bought him a boom box.
segments.zh: 因为在他14岁时，母亲给他买了一台音响。

segments.en: And by 17, he had a record deal.
segments.zh: 到17岁，他就签了唱片合约。

segments.en: Since then, he has won multiple Grammys and he's produced other artists too.
segments.zh: 此后，他多次获得格莱美奖，也为其他艺人制作音乐。
